This is an API that allows sellers to store (register/edit) quantity discounts (N+1 discount, purchase discount, multiple discount). Modifications can only be made on the event end date. Deletion is possible for events that have not yet been conducted.
Only one can be registered for each case below (N+1, one of the more you buy, discount (quantity), more you buy, more discount (amount), and multiple discount).
One product cannot be registered multiple times for secondary discounts, i.e. CM discount, N+1, purchase discount (quantity, amount, etc.), and multiple discounts.
The more you buy, the more discount you buy. Only a fixed percentage discount is possible.

post.description:
This is an API that queries shipment instructions and collection instructions for Lotte ON orders/claims.
(※ Even if the delivery status changes such as product preparation, it will be viewed as a delivery/collection order status in the corresponding API.
      After linking is complete, you must use the Lotte ON delivery status inquiry API.)

1. The seller searches the order information for shipment order and collection order and creates internal order information within the seller.
2. After creating order information within the seller, call the “Notification of shipment/collection order linkage completion” API and send the linkage result.
   (When notified of integration completion, the status will automatically change to Product Preparing or Retrieval in Progress. Please refer to the Linkage Completion Notification Guide)
(※ As of 20/05/13, street number addresses are excluded. - Lotte On is currently managed based on road name addresses.)
3. The shipping discount amount is excluded from the actual payment amount.
4. If the order progress status is shipment order or collection order, the order may be canceled or withdrawn immediately, so please make sure to notify the completion of linking after receiving the data.
5. The discount amount, shipping cost, and actual payment amount are order information based on the customer's initial payment, and information on canceled orders can be found in claim information, so please refer to this when working.
6. This API is an API for collecting order information for order delivery/collection processing. Please use the additional order information provided as an option for reference in your work.

post.description:
This is an API that conveys the status of internal processing completion of the delivery order and collection order received by the brokerage seller through the “Dispatch/recovery order (order information) inquiry” API.

Orders sent with link completion (ifCplYN)="Y" are set to not allow 'automatic immediate cancellation' in Lotte ON.
(Automatic Immediate Cancellation: Order is canceled as soon as customer cancellation is received after ordering.
 Manual cancellation approval: Seller directly approves cancellation request)
For shipment orders and collection instructions received through the “Dispatch/Recovery Instruction (Order Information) Inquiry” API, the results must be sent to the “Delivery/Recovery Instruction Link Completion Notification” API.
 From August 2, 2022, when the link completion value for a shipment order is received as =Y, the order progress status value will be changed to product ready.
 From March 30, 2023, when the link completion value for a collection order order is received as =Y, the order progress status value will be changed to collection in progress.
    However, for automatically recalled products, the status value does not change due to the recovery process even when notified of completion of linking.
    (After receiving a return/exchange, immediate withdrawal (cancellation of collection) is possible even at the return order stage. Therefore, the collection order data
     After receiving, be sure to notify the completion of linking to prevent cancellation during collection. )

post.description:
· Service purpose
     - This is an API service for sellers to transmit order progress status values to Lotte On.
     - The Lotte On order progress status value is changed based on the delivered status value, and customer notifications are sent depending on the progress stage.
     It is used as a standard refundable value.
     

· Precautions
     - If the order progress stage is not updated for a certain period of time, shipment may be delayed, order may be canceled, or a refund may be processed.
     - The order may have already been canceled due to differences in linking time, and the order may have been canceled or the quantity is larger than the quantity that can be processed.
     The update of the shipment completion status value is processed as a failure.
     - If the number of invoices (meaning the number of invoices when invoices are separated for one unit) is N, N invoice numbers must also be registered.
     - If a value that does not conform to the rules is transmitted, an error value is returned and an update failure is processed.
     - If update failure orders are continuously sent with the same content, a reception blocking policy is established for the IP in question.
     may apply.
     - Up to 500 items are possible.
     - This API does not allow editing or deleting the invoice number. If modifications are required, please use the ‘Invoice Modification Notification API’.
      

· Parameter rules
      - In case of the required value O, data can be transmitted and received only if the corresponding value is included, and the meaning of △ is conditional at a certain stage.
       Indicates a required value.

This is an API that delivers the delivery date for a delivery order from a brokerage seller. 
This is not an API that must be sent. It is a document that provides a notification service to the orderer.

The received shipping contract date is treated as an exception and the shipping contract date is exposed to FO.  
A notification text via KakaoTalk or MMS will be sent to the orderer.

post.description:
You can check the order history that has been unprocessed for more than 30 days based on Lotte On.
From the seller's perspective, it can be used to check orders that are in the status of shipment completion but whose internal status values ​​at Lotte On do not match the status values ​​such as shipment order or product preparation.
When the order status value changes and the reason for non-processing is terminated, the order is excluded from the long-term unprocessed order data.
If there is data that has been unprocessed for a long period of time, please resend the status value as Shipment Completed, Delivery Completed, Collection Confirmed, or cancel and resend the status value depending on the reason.
Long-term unprocessed data is updated every hour, every hour.
The API service will be available from 2023.1.31.
